helper.title: Mix water, yeast and honey
descriptions: Weigh all the ingredients.
In a large bowl, dissolve the yeast in the water and add the honey.

helper.title: Add the flour
descriptions: Add the flour and mix with a wooden spoon until you get a homogeneous mixture.

steps.title: Rest for { rtRestTime } hour(s) at room temperature

helper.title: Rest at room temperature
descriptions: Let it rest for { rtRestTime } hour(s) at room temperature, covered with plastic wrap.

steps.title: Rest for { coldRestTime } hour(s) in the refrigerator

helper.title: Rest in the refrigerator
descriptions: Let it rest for { coldRestTime } hour(s) in the refrigerator, covered with plastic wrap.

steps.title: Take out the poolish 1 hour before use

helper.title: How to use the poolish
descriptions: Take out the poolish 1 hour before use, so that it has time to return to room temperature.

steps.title: In the poolish, add the water and salt

helper.title: Dough preparation
descriptions: Weigh the quantities to be added to the poolish.
In the poolish bowl, add the water and salt. Mix with a wooden spoon until the water is absorbed.

steps.title: Add the flour little by little

helper.title: How to add the flour
descriptions: Add the flour little by little and mix with a wooden spoon.

steps.title: Transfer the dough to the work surface

helper.title: Transferring the dough
descriptions: Using a pastry scraper, transfer the dough to the work surface.

helper.title: Kneading
descriptions: Work the dough by kneading it, the flour must be completely integrated.

steps.title: Make a few folds and form a ball

helper.title: Folds
descriptions: To make a fold, we take the dough and fold it on itself.
We can make as many folds as we want, but the dough must be soft and supple.
The fold allows to introduce air into the dough.
Once we are done, we can form it into a beautiful ball.

helper.title: Reshape into a ball
descriptions: Do not overwork the dough.
Stretch the dough and by making it do a few turns between your hands, reshape it into a ball.

steps.title: Rest for 1 hour in an airtight container

helper.title: Form the dough balls
descriptions: Take the dough and with a dough cutter or a spatula
Form dough balls (well stretched) of about { pizzaWeight } g.
Put a thin layer of fine semolina in a dish.
Place the dough balls in a dish, leaving space between them (they will still grow).
Close the dish or put a plastic wrap.

helper.title: Dough ball rest
descriptions: The resting time of the dough ball varies depending on the temperature.
It can take between 1H and 3H, so you have to remember to take it into account 😉.

helper.title: Dough preparation
descriptions: Weigh all the ingredients.
Mix the yeast and honey with the water.

helper.title: Introduction of the flour
descriptions: Add the flour and salt and mix with a wooden spoon until you get a homogeneous mixture.

helper.title: Kneading
descriptions: Once all the ingredients are well mixed and you start to have a ball, you can place it on the work surface.
Finish kneading by hand for about 10 min (it is possible to use a stand mixer with its dough hook). Knead well to properly hydrate the flour.

helper.title: Dough ball
descriptions: Once the dough has a beautiful structure, form a ball.

steps.title: Rest for 25 min under a bowl

helper.title: Rest
descriptions: The dough will tighten and become smoother.
